decisions.headline: 《Metro 2033》与《Metro Last Light》将获新世代更新
decisions.summary: 据 IGN 报道，4A Games 将为《Metro 2033》和《Metro Last Light》推出新世代更新，PC 版计划于 10 月 22 日上线，主机版为 10 月 29 日。PC 将加入 DLSS 支持与体验改进；PS5 和 Xbox Series X 版本将提供原生 4K／60 fps 或升频 4K／120 fps 模式。完整补丁说明尚待公布。

entries.headline: Metro 2033 and Metro Last Light receive next-generation updates
entries.summary: IGN reports that 4A Games will update Metro 2033 and Metro Last Light on October 22 for PC and October 29 for consoles. PC gains DLSS support and quality-of-life improvements. PS5 and Xbox Series X versions offer native 4K at 60 fps or upscaled 4K at 120 fps. Full patch notes are still forthcoming.
